The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there is one image file.

A few notes:

- **SVG instead of PNG**: this environment has no Java/Node/Python, no PlantUML/Mermaid/Graphviz binaries, and no network access to a rendering service, so rasterization wasn't possible. SVG is the vector format you allowed — it opens in any browser or image viewer.
- **Content verified against the Structurizr MCP export**: the view shows **Patron** (person, teal `#0E7C7B`) → **Library** (software system, blue `#1168BD`), with the relationship *"Browses the catalogue through"* `[HTTPS]`. The container-level relationship (`patron → catalog`) is correctly promoted to the system level, as Structurizr does for system context views.
- **Model health**: `validate` returned OK. `inspect` flagged a few non-blocking findings (no workspace scope set, the two containers aren't on any view, missing documentation/decisions) — expected for a minimal model, and they don't affect this render. If you later add a `containerView`, I can render that one too.
